situation: 犬のかき氷屋はてんてこ舞いだ。まさに猫の手も借りたい！
english: The dog's shave ice shop is swamped, even a cat's hand could help!
explanation: 猫の手も借りたい (neko no te mo karitai) = どんな微力でも助けが欲しいほど忙しい
englishExplanation: to be so busy you'd even take help from a cat (any help at all)

situation: 町を散歩していた犬が、偶然にも宝の地図を見つけた。これはまさに犬も歩けば棒に当たるだね！
english: A dog taking a walk around town happened to find a treasure map. Truly, even a dog that walks around will bump into a stick!
hint: keep moving and you'll find something
completedKanyouku: 犬も歩けば棒に当たる
explanation: 犬も歩けば棒に当たる = 行動すれば思わぬ幸運（または災難）に出会う
englishExplanation: action brings unexpected luck or trouble

situation: 今月のお小遣いはたったの100円…これじゃあスズメの涙ほどしかないよ！
english: This month's allowance is only 100 yen... that's barely a sparrow's tears!
explanation: スズメの涙 = ほんのわずかな量
englishExplanation: a sparrow's tears — an extremely small amount

situation: 料理人を目指す少年に、プロの料理を見せても意味がない。まさに猫に小判だ！
english: Showing professional cuisine to a boy just starting out as a chef is pointless — truly gold coins to a cat!
explanation: 猫に小判 = 価値のわからない者に貴重なものを与えても無駄なこと
englishExplanation: gold coins to a cat — giving something valuable to someone who can't appreciate it

situation: 決勝戦、両チームの実力は互角。まさに竜虎相打つ勝負だ！
english: The final match — both teams evenly matched. Truly a dragon-and-tiger clash!
explanation: 竜虎相打つ = 実力の伯仲した強者同士が激しく戦うこと
englishExplanation: dragon and tiger clash — two equally powerful rivals in fierce combat
